extras: Desktop-only; local folder access is not available in the mobile app.
intentEvidence: Copying files out by hand loses that link and the recovery trail.
motivation: The author built it to allow users to remove heavy files from the vault while maintaining findability and a recovery trail.
problem: Large binary files bloat the vault, slow synchronization, and manual removal loses the link to the original file.
summary: Offloads large files from the vault to external storage (S3 or local) and replaces them with a pointer note that allows retrieval and editing.
